latestAction.text: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S3442; text: CR S3441)

summary.text: This resolution designates July 16, 2025, as Glioblastoma Awareness Day. Glioblastoma is a malignant brain tumor.

title: A resolution designating July 16, 2025, as "Glioblastoma Awareness Day".
